text:
Bo Horvat is the Islanders' captain and their hardest-matched forward, and his season is a little better than his line. He has 9 goals and 21 points in 22 games, with 10.7 expected goals on his own shots, a chance rate of 1.4 per 60, up from 1.02 last season. Goals tend to follow that.

The Islanders get 55% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, even though the shot attempts sit around even. That is usual for him: Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 99th percentile last season, and wrote that he was better than his goals. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking adds the style: 59% of his shots came off the rush, and he carries the puck in more than most.

His minutes have dipped to about 18 in three of his last four games. His last ten games were quieter, eight points against about 9.6 expected. We project around 73 points.
headline: Horvat is getting the chances, not the goals
